entries.name: snack
entries.prompt: Edit the canonical Sakura Read chibi girl into ONE new interaction sprite. Reference image 1 is canonical identity; reference image 2 is the latest approved expression rendering. Preserve exact same round face, huge head / tiny two-head-high body, long pastel pink hair and bangs, white daisy hair clip with yellow center on viewer-right, big PURPLE eyes, cream cardigan, burgundy ribbon, dark navy pleated skirt, matching socks and burgundy shoes. Soft pastel Japanese chibi cel shading, thick rounded dark-brown outline; same proportions and full-body scale as references. Full body centered, entire hair and shoes visible, genuinely transparent background, no text, symbols, scene or floor shadow. Do not redesign, change eye color, costume, hair clip, line style or age. Eating a small round pink mochi held in both hands, tiny happy chewing smile, relaxed purple eyes, cute pleased expression, standing naturally.
